title: Severe Weather Outlook, Mon, Oct 19: Marginal Risk #shorts
description:
Today's severe weather outlook from NOAA's Storm Prediction Center: Marginal Risk (level 1 of 5) for the Southeast Arizona/southwest New Mexico.

Thunderstorms may produce isolated marginally severe hail and gusty winds this afternoon and early evening across parts of southeast Arizona and southwest New Mexico.

Tornado 0%, damaging wind 5%, large hail 5% (the chance within 25 miles of a point).

Get severe weather alerts for your location, free: https://www.stormcentralwx.com

Storm Central is not an official warning system. Always follow the National Weather Service and your local emergency management.
